detector: RF-DETR Large, FP16-enabled TensorRT, 704x704, every admitted frame
auxiliary: NVIDIA BodyPose3DNet class 0 only, first target frame, keypoint confidence .75

stop.detail: Native image, engine, gateway and saved memory guard available

start.detail: Native image, engine, gateway and saved memory guard available

limits: Conditional registered actors only; image-ambiguous and unregistered/static actors remain unknown. Not HOTA/IDF1.
Two cohorts and related fixed configuration trials; no independent final third corpus or complete image annotations.
Recorded replays all used full batches; production uses partial batches. Live delivery/restart is verified, live identity accuracy is not independently qualified.
Capture SEI is an encoded-AU handoff wall clock. Physical exposure/render delay is unmeasured.
Vehicle sharing/ground position remains inadequate, especially buses and motorcycles; no production fusion qualification.
The person-trained reference ReID trial does not qualify all ReID models or prove no combined model can help.
cohortUse: Two separate periods of the same simulated scene, both used for candidate comparison. No final blind third cohort.
rawInputParity: All non-ReID trials match exactly within each cohort after excluding intentional trackingClassId metadata. The ReID trial changes confidence/box rounding in two frames, with unchanged counts/classes.
